name: text-gradient
summary: Applies a linear gradient to the text itself via background-clip.

arguments.name: $direction
accepts: a direction name such as top or bottom-left
an angle in deg, grad, rad or turn, or 0
"to top" or "to left top" as a string

arguments.name: $colors
accepts: one or more colour stops, in the same forms as linear-gradient: a colour with up to two positions, a position between two colours, or var()
a stop the browser drops is refused, because the gradient and the transparent text would go with it
